entries.english:
Parish, chaplaincy, and early Mass at Waldmannshofen.

Date range: 1437–1507, 1540–1595, 1600–1661

Contents: 1. Peter Korner and his wife Anna sell the parish priest of Waldmannshofen an annual rent of 1½ malters of grain from their fields for 20 florins, reserving the right of repurchase. Sealer: Eberhard Truchseß von Baldersheim. Original, parchment; one seal lost.
2. Rent books of the parish of Waldmannshofen, 1540 and 1567.
3. Description of the newly measured fields of the parish of Waldmannshofen, 1615.
4. Acknowledgment by Ludwig Holzmann, village mayor at Waldmannshofen, and the community concerning a testamentary endowment by the late Konrad von Rosenberg der Ältere for the poor of Waldmannshofen, 1584.
5. Bonds owed to the church of Waldmannshofen: Konrad Pfeiffer, innkeeper at Waldmannshofen, 1600; Georg Clöffel at Waldmannshofen, 1612; Hieronymus Kistner at Auerhofen, 1614; Peter Bruder at Waldmannshofen, 1595; Leonhard Klein at Waldmannshofen, 1626.
6. Disputes between the parishes of Waldmannshofen and Gülchsheim over the liability of an estate at Gülchsheim for feudal dues and rents, 1573, 1609–1613, and 1625.
7. Copies of enfeoffment, endowment, and purchase deeds concerning the chaplaincy and early Mass at Waldmannshofen, 1437, 1485, 1496–1507, 1553–1558, and 1574.
8. Salary of the parish priest of Aub for holding services in Waldmannshofen Castle, and a demand for rents and revenues from Leonhard Pfeiffer at Waldmannshofen, 1647, 1656–1661.

Extent: 1 volume.
